title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize caching and Action versions
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Improve CI runtime by splitting workflows, tighten caching keys, and bump GitHub Actions to latest stable versions. No runtime or API changes.
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflows were causing long queues, noisy reruns, and brittle cache keys. This PR splits the single node-based pipeline into three targeted workflows (lint, test, release) and standardizes Actions versions and cache keys to reduce flakiness and average CI runtime. Goals: 1) Shorter feedback loop for lint and small changes, 2) Stable, reproducible caching for node_modules and action caches, 3) Cleaner release automation with separate gating and artifacts.

What changed (single-summary):
- Added three workflows under .github/workflows/: lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml.
- Consolidated reusable job templates in .github/workflows/templates/ci-steps.yml and moved common steps to actions/google-reusable (internal) for future re-use.
- Standardized GitHub Actions versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and pinned key inputs.
- Improved cache keys to include OS, node-version, package-lock hash and workspace path to avoid cross-branch poisoning.
- Reduced test matrix from 4 -> 2 node versions for PR validation (node 18 for long-term support and node 20 for latest).
- Minor Makefile and npm script adjustments to make test targets hermetic and CI-friendly.

Commit summary (high-level):
- 1a2b3c4: feat(ci): introduce lint.yml and move lint steps out of monolithic workflow
- 2b3c4d5: feat(ci): introduce test.yml with matrix + caching improvements
- 3c4d5e6: chore(ci): add release.yml, separate release gating and artifact publishing
- 4d5e6f7: chore(ci): pin actions versions and standardize reusable job template
- 5e6f7g8: fix(ci): adjust cache keys and node-version matrix after reviewer feedback

Files changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/lint.yml (+120 additions / 10 deletions)
- .github/workflows/test.yml (+90 / +12)
- .github/workflows/release.yml (+45 / -5)
- .github/workflows/templates/ci-steps.yml (+40 / -3)
- package.json (+10 / -10)
- Makefile (+7 / -2)
- scripts/ci-helpers.sh (+6 / -0)
- docs/ci.md (update usage & expectations) (+24 / -0)

Example of cache key change (snippet):
- Old: key: node-modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
- New: key: node-modules-${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ matrix.node-version }}-${{ hashFiles(join(',', matrix.paths)) }}

CI behavior and runs:
- Initial run (2026-02-10): lint and test workflows triggered correctly but unit-tests failed due to a cached node_modules mismatch (cross-branch cache hit).
- Fix (2026-02-11): tightened cache key to include matrix.paths and node-version; reran CI.
- Subsequent runs: all checks passed; average run time reduced ~28% for typical PRs (lint ~2m -> 45s, test ~18m -> 13m).
- Release workflow verified on a staged tag push; artifact upload and semantic-release step succeeded.

Review conversation (highlights):
- Ethan Kim (reviewer): "Nice split — can we avoid re-installing deps on lint workflow? Consider a lightweight yarn check or eslint --cache to speed it further."
- Maya Patel (author): "Good call — switched lint to run with --cache and limited to changed files by default. Kept full install for test.yml only."
- Lena Rodriguez: "Cache keys look better but watch for path join() evaluation in matrix — ensure it serializes deterministically."
- Maya: "Added join(',', matrix.paths) and added a test job that prints the resolved cache key to verify determinism in a dry run."
- Samir Gupta: "Was worried about the matrix reduction removing coverage for node 16; can we confirm nobody depends on node 16 for PR checks?"
- Maya: "Node 16 is still validated in nightly pipeline (coverage/nightly.yml). Kept PR gates at 18/20 to keep feedback fast."
- CI bot: "unit-tests (ubuntu-latest, node:18) failed on first run — npm ci produced dedupe errors."
- Maya: "Fixed by re-generating lockfile for root package and adding --no-audit to speed installs in CI; documented in docs/ci.md."

Edge cases and follow-ups:  
- Follow-up task (ENG-1489): add optional job to warm caches for large monorepo consumers (scheduled workflow).
- Follow-up task (ENG-1423): migrate reusable job template into a shared internal actions repo for cross-repo reuse.

Merge details:
- After approvals from Ethan and Lena and CI green, PR was squash-merged on 2026-02-18 by Maya Patel. Commit message used: "refactor(ci): split workflows + caching hygiene — squash"

Notes for maintainers:
- If you see intermittent cache misses on forks, the recommended debug step is to rerun the cache-key-dump job in the PR to inspect computed keys.
- release.yml is gated by release-team label and requires the release token secret; documented in docs/ci.md.

This refactor is intended to be low-risk: no runtime application changes, only CI. All behavioral changes are documented and follow-up tickets have been created for warming caches and extracting reusable Actions.
